name: Ye Kahan Dark Hai Ye Toh Jindagi Hai
visual_description: Comedian Biswa Kalyan Rath speaking into a microphone with an expressive hand gesture on the Comicstaan judge panel, with yellow subtitles reading 'Ye kahan dark hai, ye toh jindagi hai'.
usage_context: Used to react sarcastically to bleak, depressing, or dark situations by stating that it is just normal everyday reality.
